string.name: desc
string.value: Attack an enemy's vital points over and over to deal tremendous damage. Cast the Assassinate skill once more after the first three strikes to deal huge critical damage. You will no longer be hidden after dealing critical damage. When used while hidden,Assassinate damage increases. Also does more damage when Body Count is 5.
